text:
Based on the provided evidence, the HepaProtect vaccine has an efficacy of 95% in preventing Hepatitis B infection specifically in healthy individuals aged 18 to 55. The information does not provide data on its efficacy or suitability for age groups outside this range (under 18 or over 55) or for individuals with specific health conditions other than those with a history of severe allergies to yeast or vaccine components, who should avoid the vaccine.
